name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Between Esther and Royce, one goes with Minnow and the other with Shrimp.
Boone's weight is higher than both Esther and Royce.
Exactly one of these is true: Esther goes with Minnow; Royce goes with Minnow; Royce goes with Shrimp.
Either Shrimp goes with Royce or Minnow goes with 7 lb.
